limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation uses a continuous assignment to propagate the one-bit input combinationally with no ports or latency added. No RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent testbench checks initial X propagation, all four logic values, and repeated binary transitions using case inequality after combinational settling. Includes fatal mismatches, bounded timeout, and final PASS. No testbench revisions.
interface_cycle_contract: TopModule(input in, output out); out continuously equals in; no clock or reset.
static_review: Single continuous driver; no state, latch, or extra latency.
